record.label: Reopen cost-closed closure branches at 2^41
record.summary: Re-audit every analytic branch previously closed only because it exceeded the 10% score floor: dense/high-rank K21 actions, spectral covariance repair, structured K4, TT3/TT4 residuals, and future-weight action states. Rank them by expected raw-MSE reduction under the full 2^41 allowance. The selected add-on is a cap2048 symmetric CP4 carrier: it appends one coordinate birth block per reset, retains the stable top-energy 2048 atoms, and hands every dropped d/K31/K22 plane back to the coherent H4 residual. Its independent cost audit conservatively priced 234.508B FLOPs. The complete frozen V1 then measured 2.180585T FLOPs, confirming that this once cost-closed state fits under 2^41. Cap2560 and Q>32 remain held because the literal safety margin is only 18.439B FLOPs.
record.terminal_criterion: Produce a hash-bound table of every economically closed high-accuracy branch, its best prior accuracy evidence, exact or conservative Phase 2 FLOPs/memory/residual estimate, and a promote/reject decision under 2^41.
